CAND_OFFICE_ST=OR, CAND_ELECTION_YR=2026, House+Senate only. MEMO_CD=X skipped. Joint committees (CMTE_DSGN=J) are not treated as PCC. This is federal FEC only; Oregon has no free statewide ORESTAR/Schedule A bulk. Names are copied from the filing extract only and are never invented. Street addresses omitted. Donor lists are not sold. OpenFEC/DEMO_KEY is not used. No Ballotpedia. No scores.
